newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key Euroyen futures end slightly easier in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Key Euroyen futures end slightly easier in Tokyo.

text.p: Key December three-month Euroyen deposit rate futures ended slightly easier in Tokyo on Monday in subdued trade ahead of the release of the Bank of Japan's key "tankan" survey of corporate sentiment on Wednesday.

Light corrective selling capped the topside of the key contract after its rally to as high as 99.23 in the night session on Friday due to a widespread view that the tankan will confirm the weakness of the economy's recovery, traders said.
"The key contract's rise to 99.23 was extreme," said a commercial bank dealer. The key December ended down 0.01 at 99.17 after moving between 99.17 and 99.19. It opened at 99.19.
